title: CIPA® Fellowship (Certified Islamic Professional Accountant)
body: Accounting and Auditing Organization for Islamic Financial Institutions (AAOIFI)
summary: The premier technical professional accountancy, financial reporting (FAS), and auditing qualification for Islamic financial institutions globally, spanning 4 modular examination syllabi and 1 year practical experience.

standard.name: Standard CIPA Fellowship Track
standard.blurb: Complete all 4 modular examinations (FAR, AUD, BLG, SSOR) with at least 70% pass score, and complete 1 year of verified practical experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Module 1 — Financial Accounting and Reporting (FAR)
stages.subtitle: AAOIFI Financial Accounting Standards (FAS) mechanics and disclosures

nodes.name: Financial Accounting and Reporting for IFIs
nodes.description: AAOIFI conceptual framework, recognition and measurement of Murabahah (FAS 28), Mudarabah (FAS 13), Musharakah (FAS 4), Ijarah (FAS 32), Sukuk (FAS 33/34), Zakah (FAS 35), and consolidated accounts.
topics: AAOIFI FAS Conceptual Framework & Objective of Financial Reporting for IFIs
Accounting for Financing Contracts: Murabahah, Salam, Istisna'a, and Tawarruq
Accounting for Equity & Leasing: Mudarabah, Musharakah, and Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek
Accounting for Investments: Investment in Sukuk, Shares, Real Estate & Funds
Financial Statement Disclosures, PSIA Reserves (PER/IRR) & Zakah Accounting

nodes.name: FAR Modular Examination
nodes.format: 100 MCQs and Practical Accounting Problem Scenarios
nodes.description: Computer-based modular exam testing journal entries, accounting adjustments, and balance sheet preparation under AAOIFI FAS standards. Passing score: 70%.

stages.title: Stage 2: Module 2 — Audit and Governance (AUD)
stages.subtitle: Auditing Standards for Islamic Financial Institutions (ASIFI) and SSB governance

nodes.name: Audit and Governance for IFIs
nodes.description: AAOIFI Auditing Standards (ASIFI), external audit engagements, internal Shari'ah audit, Shari'ah governance frameworks (GS 1-11), and risk-based audit planning.
topics: ASIFI Auditing Principles, Engagement Planning & Risk Assessment for IFIs
Internal Shari'ah Review (GS 3) & Internal Shari'ah Audit Charter
Shari'ah Supervisory Board (SSB) Relations, Fatwa Governance & Independence
Auditing Profit Allocation between Shareholders and Unrestricted Investment Account Holders

nodes.name: AUD Modular Examination
nodes.description: Computer-based exam testing external and internal audit procedures and Shari'ah governance. Passing score: 70%.

stages.title: Stage 3: Modules 3 & 4 — Law, Ethics & Shari'ah Standards
stages.subtitle: Business Law & Ethics (BLG) and Shari'ah Standards Operational Requirements (SSOR)

nodes.name: Business Law and Ethics (BLG)
nodes.description: Commercial jurisprudence, contract law, regulatory frameworks for IFIs, corporate governance, and AAOIFI Code of Ethics for Accountants.
topics: Principles of Commercial Jurisprudence (Fiqh al-Mu'amalat)
Contract Formation, Defects of Will, and Dispute Settlement in Islamic Law
Corporate Governance, Transparency & AAOIFI Code of Professional Ethics

nodes.name: Shari'ah Standards & Operational Requirements (SSOR)
nodes.description: Operational compliance with core AAOIFI Shari'ah Standards in banking, treasury, trade finance, Sukuk, and takaful operations.
topics: Operational Application of AAOIFI Shari'ah Standards
Treasury Operations, Liquidity Management & FX Hedging in Islamic Banking
Sukuk Structuring, Securitization Vehicles & SPV Governance

nodes.name: BLG & SSOR Modular Examinations
nodes.description: Modular assessments testing legal contracts, ethics, and operational compliance with AAOIFI Shari'ah standards. Passing score: 70%.

stages.title: Stage 4: Practical Experience & Fellowship Induction
stages.subtitle: 1 Year Verified Experience in IFI Accounting / Audit

nodes.name: 1 Year Practical Experience in Islamic Finance
nodes.description: Document at least 12 months of qualifying practical accounting or auditing experience in an Islamic bank, takaful company, regulatory authority, or audit firm.
topics: 12 Months Verified Work Experience
Supervisory Verification in Islamic Accounting

nodes.name: CIPA Fellowship Conferred
nodes.description: Formal award of the Certified Islamic Professional Accountant (CIPA) fellowship credential by AAOIFI.
topics: CIPA Fellowship Award
Listing in Global AAOIFI Registry
Annual CPD Commitment
